name: foreman
description: Coordinate long-running Claude Code work as background threads: implement → review → apply, from one chat

claudeExe.title: Claude Code executable
claudeExe.description: The `claude` command foreman runs to start and watch threads. Empty: `claude` from PATH.

notifyCommand.title: Notify command
notifyCommand.description: Run on each cycle notice, by argv with no shell; {{message}} is replaced by the notice (else it is appended). Example: powershell.exe -NoProfile -File C:\tools\notify.ps1 {{message}}. Empty: toasts only.
